sourceType: Official Rajasthan Tourism website (Government of Rajasthan)
note: Facts extracted below; prose summaries in our own words, not copied verbatim from the source.
about: Planned by Vidyadhar Bhattacharya, India's first planned city, founded 1727 by Jai Singh II who moved his capital from Amber. Painted pink in 1876 for the Prince of Wales' visit under Maharaja Ram Singh. Part of the Golden Triangle (Delhi-Agra-Jaipur).

places.name: Samode
places.location: 40km northwest of Jaipur on Jaipur-Sikar road
places.facts: 475-year-old Samode Palace, Rajput haveli architecture; Samode Bagh luxury tent camp; camel safari through village, local craftsmen visits.

places.name: Light & Sound Show at Jainiwas Udhyan
places.facts: First 3-D projection mapping light & sound show in Rajasthan; depicts the story of the Govind Dev Ji temple's idol.

places.name: Amber Palace (Amer Fort)
places.facts: UNESCO World Heritage Site; Kachwaha capital before Jaipur; construction started 1592 by Raja Man Singh I, completed by Mirza Raja Jai Singh; red sandstone and white marble; overlooks Maota Lake.

places.name: City Palace
places.facts: Built by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II; still home to the royal family (private section); includes Mubarak Mahal (Maharaja Sawai Man Singh II Museum, royal costumes/textiles) and Maharani's Palace (Rajput weaponry from 15th century).

places.name: Jantar Mantar
places.facts: UNESCO World Heritage Site; largest of 5 astronomical observatories built by Sawai Jai Singh II; 16 geometric devices; has an Interpretation Centre.

places.name: Hawa Mahal
places.facts: Built 1799 by Sawai Pratap Singh as a summer retreat / purdah viewing structure for royal ladies; 5-storey pink sandstone, jharokha lattice windows resembling Krishna's crown; maintained by Archaeological Dept of Rajasthan; houses an archaeological museum.

places.name: Albert Hall Museum (Central Museum)
places.facts: Named after Victoria & Albert Museum London; designed by Sir Swinton Jacob, Indo-Saracenic style; foundation laid 1876 by Prince of Wales; metal objects, woodcrafts, carpets, arms, miniature paintings from Bundi/Kota/Kishangarh/Udaipur/Jaipur schools.

places.name: Nahargarh Fort
places.facts: Built 1734 under Jai Singh, expanded 1868; 'abode of tigers'; houses Madhavendra Bhawan (12 queen boudoirs by Sawai Madho Singh); floodlit at night.

places.name: Jaigarh Fort
places.facts: Built by Sawai Jai Singh II early 18th century; houses Jaiban, the world's largest cannon.

places.name: Birla Temple (Lakshmi-Narayan Temple)
places.location: Base of Moti Dungari, south Jaipur
places.facts: Built 1988 by the Birla family, white marble; dedicated to Vishnu (Narayan) and Lakshmi; 3 domes representing 3 religions; includes a museum of Birla family belongings.

places.name: Jal Mahal
places.facts: Lake Palace appearing to float in the centre of Man Sagar Lake; sand-coloured stone walls.

places.name: Gaitore (Memorials of Kings)
places.facts: Royal cenotaphs (chhatris) of former Jaipur Maharajas in white marble; Maharaja Jai Singh's chhatri has 20 carved pillars.

places.name: Sisodia Rani Palace and Garden
places.facts: Built by Sawai Jai Singh II for his Sisodia queen; Mughal-style multi-tiered garden with Radha-Krishna murals, fountains.

places.name: Vidyadhar Garden
places.facts: Named after Vidyadhar Bhattacharya, Jaipur's chief architect.

places.name: Central Park
places.facts: Jaipur's largest park, built by Jaipur Development Authority; Polo Ground, golf club; India's first all-day-all-night monumental National Flag, country's tallest flagpole.

places.name: Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing
places.facts: Restored haveli museum of block-printed textiles, tools, related objects.

places.name: Govind Devji Temple
places.facts: Rare spire-less Krishna temple; idol brought from Vrindavan by Sawai Jai Singh.

places.name: Moti Doongri Ganesh Temple
places.facts: Built early 18th century by Seth Jai Ram Paliwal; important Ganesh temple; hill also has a Scottish-castle-replica palace (royal family property, not public).

places.name: Digamber Jain Mandir (Sanghiji Temple)
places.facts: Principal idol of Lord Adinath in Padmasan posture; red stone, 7-storey shikharas.

places.name: Galtaji
places.facts: Pilgrimage site with temples, pavilions, holy kunds; Ramgopalji Temple = 'Monkey Temple' (Galwar Bagh); Surya Mandir at hilltop built by Diwan Kriparam.

places.name: Statue Circle
places.facts: Life-size white marble statue of Sawai Jai Singh II.

places.name: Ram Niwas Garden
places.facts: Built 1868 by Maharaja Sawai Ram Singh; houses Albert Hall Museum, bird park, zoo, Ravindra Rang Manch theatre, art gallery.

places.name: Kanak Vrindavan
places.location: Foothills of Nahargarh, on the way to Amber
places.facts: Landscaped garden with carved temple, marble columns/lattices; popular film shoot location.

places.name: Ishwar Lat (Sargasuli)
places.facts: 60ft minaret built 1749 by Raja Ishwari Singh to commemorate a victory; also called 'Swarg Suli'.

places.name: Amar Jawan Jyoti
places.facts: Memorial to Rajasthan's martyrs; eternal flame at 4 corners.

places.name: Maharani Ki Chhatri (Memorials of Queens)
places.location: On the way to Amber Fort
places.facts: Royal women's cremation site; cenotaph roof only completed if queen predeceased king.

places.name: Nahargarh Biological Park
places.facts: 720 hectares under Aravalli range; 285+ bird species incl. white-naped tit (only found here); Nahargarh Zoological Park has Asiatic lions, Bengal tigers, panthers, sloth/Himalayan black bear. Zoo timings: 15 Mar-14 Oct 8:30am-5:30pm, 15 Oct-14 Mar 9am-5pm, closed Tuesdays. Entry: Indian Rs 50, Foreigner Rs 300, Student Rs 20; vehicle/camera fees separately listed.

places.name: Jaipur Wax Museum
places.facts: 30+ wax statues incl. Amitabh Bachchan, Gandhi, Bhagat Singh, Einstein, Michael Jackson; combo with Sheesh Mahal. Timings 10am-6:30pm daily. Tickets: Rs 500 Indians, Rs 700 combo for international travellers.

places.name: Jawahar Kala Kendra (JKK)
places.facts: Established 1993; navgraha (9 planets) architectural theme; 6 exhibition galleries, auditoriums, Shilpgram complex; Indian Coffee House.

places.name: Raj Mandir Cinema
places.facts: Iconic single-screen cinema established 1976; asymmetrical exterior, chandeliers.

places.name: Sambhar Lake
places.facts: Largest inland salt lake in India; flamingo sightings; Shakambhari Mata Temple sunset views; Salt Works railway; Devyani Kund, Sharmishtha Sarovar, Salt Museum nearby.

places.name: Madhvendra Palace, Nahargarh
places.location: ~15km from Jaipur, within Nahargarh Fort, 700ft elevation
places.facts: Built by Sawai Ram Singh for his 9 queens; double-storeyed, 9 apartments with flower-motif murals.

places.name: Akshardham Temple
places.facts: Modern temple to Narayan, silver/gold-ornamented statue; lush gardens, fountains.

places.name: Jagat Shiromani Temple
places.facts: Built c.1599-1608 by Queen Kanakwati (wife of Man Singh I) in memory of son Jagat Singh; dedicated to Krishna/Vishnu; idols said to be those worshipped by Meera Bai; Jain-Hindu-Mughal-South Indian architectural blend.

places.name: Sculpture Park (Nahargarh)
places.facts: Government of Rajasthan + SathSaath Arts collaboration; contemporary indoor/outdoor sculpture gallery.

places.name: Jawahar Circle
places.facts: Largest circular park in Asia; rose garden, jogging tracks; Musical Fountain with 270+ effects, 300+ lights, up to 25ft height; evening show 30 min starting 7pm.

places.name: Museum of Gem and Jewellery
places.location: Rajasthan Chambers building, near New Gate, Jaipur
places.facts: Gem/jewellery history and craftsmanship displays; donated pieces from jewellers worldwide.

places.name: Jhalana Safari Park
places.facts: 1978 hectares; popular for leopard sightings (15-20 panthers); royal hunting ground until 1860; Dr Brandis appointed forest administrator 1862; also striped hyena, desert fox, golden jackal, chital; Shikar Oudhi (1835), Kali Mata temple, Jain Chulgiri temple.

places.name: Masala Chowk
places.facts: 21 street food stalls; Rs 10 entry; best visited evenings.

places.name: Amrapali Museum
places.facts: Private jewellery museum by Amrapali Jewels founders; 4000+ piece collection, ~800 on display. Timings 11am-6pm Mon-Sat. Ticket Rs 600 (audio guide included).

places.name: Museum of Legacies
places.facts: Opened 9 Dec 2017 in a ~200-year-old building; 8 galleries on Rajasthani textiles, jewellery, stoneware, painting, pottery.

places.name: Museum on Political Narratives, Rajasthan Legislative Assembly
places.facts: Digital museum inaugurated 16 July 2022; Rajasthan's political history and democratic framework, bilingual (Hindi/English).

howToReach.air: Jaipur International Airport (Sanganer Airport); domestic flights to Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Jodhpur, Udaipur; international to Dubai, Muscat, Singapore, Bangkok
howToReach.rail: Connected to Delhi, Agra, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Bikaner, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Ahmedabad, Bangalore
howToReach.road: Regular AC/Deluxe bus service from all major Rajasthan cities
